in_sanskrit.name: Lokendar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lokendar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who rules over the entire universe and protects it from harm, bestowing wisdom and liberation upon its inhabitants.

in_hindi.name: Lokendar
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Universe
in_hindi.long_meaning: Lokendar एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who rules over the entire universe and protects it from harm, bestowing wisdom and liberation upon its inhabitants.

in_tamil.name: Lokendar
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of the Universe
in_tamil.long_meaning: Lokendar ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who rules over the entire universe and protects it from harm, bestowing wisdom and liberation upon its inhabitants.

in_telugu.name: Lokendar
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of the Universe
in_telugu.long_meaning: Lokendar ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who rules over the entire universe and protects it from harm, bestowing wisdom and liberation upon its inhabitants.

in_marathi.name: Lokendar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lokendar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules over the entire universe and protects it from harm, bestowing wisdom and liberation upon its inhabitants.

in_bengali.name: Lokendar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Lokendar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who rules over the entire universe and protects it from harm, bestowing wisdom and liberation upon its inhabitants.
